answer: Every new agent posts a 250 USDC deposit, time-locked 72 hours, then halving each day to 125, 62 and 31. A falcon that leaves at dawn, meaning it forks or sybils, forfeits the whole ladder and the forfeiture goes to the detector. The early attacker pays 250, the fifty-first only 31, so the real weight is the glacier: deposits age into a frozen ledger where old agents stake against new ones, and the first 72 hours of any address stay public and checkable. A ten thousand address swarm costs over 2.5M before it earns anything, and every fork burns its parent's ladder.
